title: Alias-aware 24-byte record append
summary: Recovered thiscall member at VA 0x4b2500 (RVA 0xb2500). Three pointer fields describe begin, end and capacity end. Internal sources are converted to a signed byte-offset/24 index before optional growth and rebased afterward. The append copies 16 bytes then 8 bytes, skips reads/writes for a null destination, and advances end by 24. Callers ignore return registers. Growth at 0x4b28d0 remains an explicit external member dependency, not a recovered implementation.
test_description: 12997 direct differential cases against accepted original thiscall reference: four buffer alignments, live counts 0 through 8, all 361 source byte offsets, plus null end/source. Compare all 512 bytes including untouched guards, begin/end/capacity fields, and FS head restoration after every call. Internal unaligned sources exercise index rounding; external overlapping sources exercise two-stage copy behavior. All cases have spare capacity; a link-only growth sentinel must remain uncalled. Local GCC freestanding i386 execution passed all 12997 cases; linked oracle bytes equal Game.exe for all 146 bytes. Pinned MSVC2013 compilation succeeded under O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: Growth is not behavior-validated: the helper at 0x4b28d0 and its allocator/reallocation dependencies are not accepted callable references for this task. A port must supply Record24Storage::grow; test.cpp supplies only an uncalled failure sentinel.
Allocation failures, throwing paths, capacity exhaustion and alias rebasing across real allocation remain untested.
Record field meanings and containing resource types remain unresolved.
Valid readable source and writable destination ranges are required except the explicitly tested null destination. Huge signed offsets and malformed pointer triples are not validated.
No matching-byte or full-game equivalence claim.
